message.content:
This editorial illustration for Tempo magazine features a stylized depiction of a man in a tan suit, shown from the chest up. His body is positioned as if he is bracing himself between two thick, fluted grey columns. One leg is raised, with a black shoe pressed against the left column, while his right arm is extended behind him, fingers splayed against the right column. His head is turned to the side with a tense facial expression.

The illustration is set against a stark white background within the architectural frame. At the top, the large red word "TEMPO" is partially obscured by the man's head. Smaller black text above it reads "PEMAIN BESAR MINUMAN KERAS ILEGAL" and "EROTISME STENSILAN ENNY ARROW". Below the man, large dark blue text reads "KEJARLAH DAKU, KAU KUBEKAP". Underneath, smaller text mentions "KPK", "SETYA NOVANTO", and "ISTANA". At the bottom right, there is a date of "16-22 OKTOBER 2017", a price of "RP 45.000", and a barcode. A solid red border runs along the left and bottom edges of the cover.
